messages.description: HTML and interactive SVG preview: shown when the web view content process crashed
HTML and interactive SVG preview: shown when the web view content process was stopped by the system or became unresponsive
HTML and interactive SVG preview: shown when loading the page failed
SVG preview bar: toggle button enabling native interactive SVG mode (hover, click, links, and scripts)
SVG preview bar: tooltip when interactive SVG mode cannot open isolated web pages

en-US.desktop.htmlPreview.crashed: This preview stopped unexpectedly. Reload to continue.
en-US.desktop.htmlPreview.stopped: This preview was stopped. Reload to restore it.
en-US.desktop.svg.interactive: Interactive mode (enable SVG hover, click, links, and scripts)
en-US.desktop.svg.interactiveUnavailable: Interactive mode is unavailable because isolated web pages could not be opened.

zh-CN.desktop.htmlPreview.crashed: 此预览意外停止。请重新加载以继续。
zh-CN.desktop.htmlPreview.stopped: 此预览已停止。请重新加载以恢复。
zh-CN.desktop.svg.interactive: 交互模式（启用 SVG 悬停、点击、链接与脚本交互）
zh-CN.desktop.svg.interactiveUnavailable: 交互模式不可用，无法打开隔离网页视图。
